native_full_184.decision: DeepSeek. The current two-investigation interactive schedule does not provide evidence of the very high sustained GPU batching needed to beat API cost. Typical planning sensitivities250-1000aggregate outputtps are more expensive. The optimistic10000tps scenario can overlap API cost but is unmeasured, excludes prefill and tool-idle time, and requires checkpoint/quality qualification. Reassess for a larger saturated workload or an existing warm qualified endpoint; do not claim the API is always cheaper. NoGPUallocation.
